name: Forward-Back Rope Jump Against the Clock
setup: Rope behind the heels, handles at the hips, elbows close to the sides.
cues: Count clean reps in the time; a rep that is not clean does not count.
Jump the rope forward and back over a line on the floor, light and quick.
Small, quiet contacts on the floor, an inch high.

faults.fault: Jumping too high over the rope
faults.fix: Clear the rope by an inch: small, quiet contacts on the floor.
Keep the handles at the hips and turn the rope with small circles.
